load_urdf_quadruped: load a URDF quadruped robot model into a PyBullet physics simulation
reset_joint_state: reset joint positions on a loaded robot body using an array of target values
set_joint_motor_control: configure velocity control mode on all joints of a PyBullet robot body
create_constraint_point2point: create a point-to-point constraint between two joints on a robot body
step_simulation: step the PyBullet physics simulation forward and then disconnect from the server
